Name: BTD Lawrence portrait and sprites

Description:
A simple portrait and sprite replace of Shane to make him look like Lawrence from Boyfriend to death 2: Fresh blood. It seems to all be working but there's one sprite i can't find, the one where he's passed out. I can't edit it since i can't find it, so that's the only messed up sprite.

Lawrence and the art used for the first image belongs to Gatobob at http://gatobob.tumblr.com/.
